links.outcome: Authenticity of references cited by chatbots in diabetic foot ulcer answers
links.effect: Claude-2 had 99.6% verified references; ChatGPT had the lowest reference authenticity at 66.3%, showing AI hallucinated references.
links.quote: Claude-2 outperformed other chatbots in the number of verified references (99.6%), whereas ChatGPT had the lowest rate of reference authenticity (66.3%).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the accuracy and reference hallucination rate of seven LLM chatbots on clinical guideline questions for diabetic foot ulcer management, without testing specific deployment practices or organizational safeguards.
